content:
Apple TV has unveiled the trailer for Nocturne, a brand-new thriller series adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling crime novel The Sandman.

Nocturne is a brand-new thriller series premiering on October 30.

Apple TV's library boasts an impressive array of crime and thriller titles, and they're set to add even more this autumn.

One such addition is Nocturne, adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling novel The Sandman.

Nocturne will premiere on Friday, October 30, with the first two episodes dropping immediately. New episodes will then arrive weekly until December 25.

The series follows a serial killer and stars Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Adolescence's Stephen Graham playing the role of the killer.

Apple has just released the trailer, giving us a glimpse into this terrifying new series. Here's the official synopsis for Nocturne, plus the trailer itself.

Two weeks before Nocturne premieres, another crime thriller, 12 12 12, will debut on Apple TV. Starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, the series revolves around a heist, chronicling 12 months of preparation, 12 hours of the operation itself, and the 12 days that follow.

Looking beyond autumn, Apple is gearing up to kick off 2027 with the highly anticipated thriller The Wanted Man, starring Hugh Laurie as the head of an organized crime syndicate.

Will you be tuning in to watch Nocturne when it premieres next month? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can enjoy a discounted rate by bundling it with the Apple One subscription plan.
